_comment: Test tiers for CI. 'green' is run on every push; when 'enforce' is true a failure blocks the build. 'quarantine' lists files excluded on purpose, each with the reason. Regenerate with: python3 ci/triage.py --promote

quarantine.reason: Needs the INPOP ephemeris data (inpop21a_TDB_m100_p100_*_pos_*.mat), which Installer.install() fetches into $ASTROPACK_DATA_PATH. A hosted runner has no such data. Fix by caching the INPOP files in CI, or by running on a self-hosted runner that already has them.

All 5 cases are off by exactly 0.04 deg (2.4 arcmin; 6.98e-4 rad in the radian case), with a consistent relative error of -6.7178e-4. A constant offset that clean points at a changed convention or constant -- e.g. an observatory longitude -- rather than numerical drift. The gate is AbsTol 1e-6, so it cannot be tolerance noise. Needs an owner to decide whether the code or the expected values moved.

PRODUCT BUG: celestial.coo.sphere_dist_fastSmall line 13 is a literal error('BUG'). The function is unimplemented; every test calling it errors. Either finish it or delete both.
Off-by-one: testLargeInputPerformance expects 1000000 rows and gets 999999. Either the function drops a row or the test's expected size is wrong.

setupOnce errors with 'Regression data file does not exist. Run the regression data generation script first.' The generator has never been run, so no fixture exists.
testCentersWithinExpandedRadius: 0.1083 exceeds the 0.0956 bound. Marginal -- likely a tolerance that was never calibrated.
PRODUCT BUG: celestial.healpix.findNeighbors line 98 throws MATLAB:sub2ind:IndexOutOfRange for the negative-index case.
testVerticesNearPixelCenter: 8 vertex distances are ~2-3x the allowed bound (0.46-0.77 vs 0.227). Either the vertices are wrong or the tolerance is.
TEST BUG: testRasterizePolygonMexSmoke calls rasterize_polygon(P0, 3); the MEX requires NSide to be a power of 2, so 3 is invalid input from the test itself.

testMaxRadiusGeEqualAreaRadius fails at every NSide: maxRadius is consistently BELOW equalAreaRadius (0.5 vs 0.907, 0.25 vs 0.453, ...), a clean factor. Looks like an inverted or mis-scaled formula on one side.

Real cross-match logic failures: source counts 28 vs 12 and 18 vs 10, Nmatch 0 vs 2, KeepExtraMatches returning NaN, and XIDREF returned where XIDA was expected. Needs an owner who knows crossIDCatsHTM.

@Base handle/value semantics: createNewObj and copy return objects that compare equal to the original, and isemptyProperty returns 1x2 where 2x1 is expected. Either @Base changed or these expectations were always wrong.

TEST BUG: two cases call verifyContains(testCase, ...), which does not exist for FunctionTestCase -- the function-based API has no such method. The third expects MATLAB:badfid_mx but gets MATLAB:class:InvalidHandle.
tools.array.nan2val leaves one NaN unreplaced at (2,3) under default arguments.
struct2keyval returns a 1x0 cell for an empty struct where the test expects 0x0. Cosmetic, but it is a real behaviour/expectation mismatch.

_status: Verified against CI run #4 (367 tests: 244 passed, 111 failed, 12 skipped). Every green file passed or skipped cleanly there, so enforce is on. Quarantined files each carry the measured reason.
